description: JSON_INDENT sets how wide a semi-structured value is displayed: this engine's own default is COMPACT (its canonical rendering) while a real account defaults to two spaces; the parameter itself behaves as live's does and the indented form is byte-identical to a real account's at the same width. Width 2 and 4 renderings (nested arrays indenting one level further), empty containers never split, TO_VARCHAR always compact, UNSET restoring the engine default, and SHOW PARAMETERS reporting live's default (2), description and NUMBER type. Converted 1:1 from features/JsonIndentTest (now retired). Tests pinning the engine's compact default or the indented renders skip the snowflake backend (live's session default differs and the live harness normalisation the Java class assumed is absent here).
